authority: #K2-362 sec.2.5 (hard precondition: answer the product three questions BEFORE implementing) + constitution sec.20

Q1_same_kind_product_exists.in_repo: YES - this repository already ships deterministic routers on the live chain: tools/k2_route_segment_v1.py is an orchestrator (canonicalise -> DRC -> route -> zone fill) that dispatches a router family (ROUTERS table: k2_p4_gnd_vias_v1, k2_p4_converge_v1, ...); in exam A attempt 1 it produced the whole board (stage2 b15c63d5a8df3f00)
Q1_same_kind_product_exists.external: YES - the industry solves exactly this (KiCad interactive router, FreeRouting, commercial autorouters), but those are interactive or stochastic and none has been licence-reviewed here
Q1_same_kind_product_exists.reading: a product is available both in-repo and in the industry; the in-repo one is the strongest input because it is already on the live chain

primary_in_repo: tools/k2_route_segment_v1.py (orchestration + router dispatch + DRC + zone fill)
tools/k2_reroute_affected_v2.py (C17 v1: clip -> island-MST stitch -> snap -> bounded repair -> normalise)
Q2_copyable_product_artifact.reference_library: REF-CASE-LIBRARY: NOT FOUND in this repo at the referenced path (searched docs/ and the tree) - recorded rather than pretended; the fallback input is the in-repo product above
Q2_copyable_product_artifact.reading: the emission/oracle/polish layers ARE copyable in-repo products; M3 must COPY those, not reinvent them

what_the_in_repo_products_do_NOT_do: PATH SOLVING: the chain's routers are DRAWING-DRIVEN - they lay a KNOWN polyline from the W3 joint assignment; they never solve a path for a torn net
MULTI-PAD: no deterministic pad-set connection (MST) exists
VIA / MULTI-LAYER: no layer-change insertion for a blocked pair (M3 v1 is single-layer, declared)
LENGTH RE-TUNING for a MOVED cluster (C3)
CHAMFER RECOVERY for a MOVED cluster (C4)
Q3_difference_list.consequence: M3's expansion = ADD path solving (multi-pad MST + via/multi-layer) and WIRE the copyable layers (emission/oracle/polish) around it; do NOT write a new stochastic autorouter (that would violate constitution sec.20 sec.5)
